note.zh: 释放的囚犯多为罪犯：1800天犯罪修正，新增人口。
note.en: Mostly criminals: a 1800-day crime modifier and new pops.

note.zh: 罪犯与异见者兼有：两种修正，新增人口。
note.en: Criminals and dissidents alike: both modifiers and new pops.

note.zh: 几乎全是艺术家、作家等异见者：永久修正，新增人口。
note.en: Almost all artists and other dissidents: a permanent modifier and new pops.

notes.zh: 审阅注：四种处置——留作监狱（静滞监狱矿藏，结束）；释放（非格式塔）→ 60–120天后随机：坏邻居25/大杂烩50/好邻居25，亲外与排外帝国权重各±15；逐步释放（和平、平等或警察国家）→ 融合矿藏与新人口，结束；吞噬虫群 → 当作储备食物，结束。
notes.en: Review note: four choices — keep it as a prison (stasis prison deposit, end); release them (non-gestalt) → 60–120 days later at random Bad 25 / Mixed 50 / Good 25, shifted ±15 for xenophile or xenophobe empires; gradual release (pacifist, egalitarian or Police State) → integration deposit and new pops, end; Devouring Swarm → stored meals, end.

scope.en: All 7 Stasis Prison events and the Particle Mystery project.
